name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 26 times in 8 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 53 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-10-17, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
